Both navy sleeve tubes start below exposed upper-arm skin. The native wardrobe crop shows continuous skin above each sleeve top and separate bodice straps on the torso; there is no visible textile bridge across either upper-arm gap. Each sleeve continues as a bell shape to its own wrist.

Narrow coral edge lines follow the square neckline, vertical bodice seams, waist seam, sleeve top edges and curved bell cuffs while navy remains the dominant cloth. The cuff lines bend with the garment perimeter and folds instead of reading as broad panels or free printed motifs; these are visible seam/edge-trim paths at native scale.
